label: Answer requests (template)
summary: Marks the turns where a learner asks for the answer instead of help. A template: copy it to start a component of your own.

evidence.original: None: it matches a few phrases, and was written to show the shape of a component.
evidence.integration: Its fixtures pass through callComponent in the harness's tests; its marks have not been compared with teachers' labels.
evidence.unknown: Whether these phrases find the turns a teacher would mark. A real detector reports its agreement with teachers' labels on a sample.

risk_notes: A wrong mark misleads a teacher. It runs on this machine, calls no model and sends nothing elsewhere.
